question.explanationHtml: We expect more than 100 members to attend the annual meeting.

question.transcriptHtml: As soon as we arrive at the hotel, we will get in touch with the manager about the unexpected guests.

question.explanationHtml: The morning sessions tend to fill up first, so sign up early.
